steps: Shut off the main water supply immediately.
Dry the pipe and identify whether the leak is at a joint, fitting, or pinhole.
For a quick stop-gap, use a pipe repair clamp or epoxy putty rated for water lines.
For a permanent fix on copper/PVC, cut out and re-solder or re-glue the section.
If it's inside a wall or the damage is extensive, call a licensed plumber.
